neighbours.label: the marker of a concessive conditional: 'if' in 'even if', 'though' in 'even though', 'даже если', 'no matter what'; a plain conditional 'if' and 'even' without a concession stay quiet
fire: The ferry still sails every morning, even if the sea is rough.
I will finish this essay tonight, even if it takes until midnight.
She wore the red coat, even though her mother hated it.
The shop stays open on holidays, even if only a few customers come.
Keep your seatbelt fastened, even if the light is switched off.
They planted the field anyway, even if the rain never came.
Мы пойдём гулять, даже если будет холодно.
He refused to apologize, no matter what the teacher said.
quiet: The ferry does not sail in the morning if the sea is rough.
I will finish this essay tonight if I have the time.
She wore the red coat because her mother liked it.
The shop stays open on holidays if enough customers come.
Unfasten your seatbelt if the light is switched off.
They planted the field early, and even the rain came on time.
Мы пойдём гулять, если будет тепло.
He apologized at once when the teacher asked him.

predictions: 'even if' / 'even though' / 'даже если' 0.3-0.8; plain conditional 'if' and scalar 'even' below 0.1
notes: Card: 'even if' x many, 'yea though', 'даже', Arabic 'حتى وإن', 'no matter that'. Probe: 'even if it rains all week' 0.738, 'даже если' 0.521, 'no matter what' 0.371, 'even though' 0.264; plain 'If it rains tomorrow' 0.060, 'if I had the money' 0.016, 'Even the smallest children' 0.084.
